name: CM262 EO/IR/SWIR gimbal (CACI)
description: Four-sensor 16 kg gimbal on the L-MADIS sensor vehicle: HD EO, HD MWIR, SWIR and a laser rangefinder, 360 deg continuous in azimuth and +90 to -16 deg in elevation, with on-board C-UAS tracking. CACI publishes no detection or identification range against any target, so the ring is REPRESENTATIVE. The datasheet's 16 km is the laser rangefinder's ranging range, not a detection range.

classifyRangeM.condition: identification range — REPRESENTATIVE, set equal to detectRangeM. Basis: this gimbal's role in L-MADIS is visual identification on a radar cue, so the detection event and the identification event are the same event. Matches the convention used for lib-wisp.
classifyRangeM.source: CACI, 'CM262 ground system - Multi-mission ISR and C-sUAS' datasheet (PDF), linked from https://www.caci.com/eo-ir-imaging-systems
classifyRangeM.note: Inventory records 5000 m at UNKNOWN REPRESENTATIVE; the seed leaves the field null
